fixtures.demo-hybrid: ISS-t125-3 re-walk: one flow both CLICKs 'Sign up with Google' and FILLs {{SECRET:HYBRID_PASSWORD}} (unset), plus one unrelated credential-free flow.
fixtures.demo-overblock: NEW checker-found fixture: a plain login flow FILLs {{SECRET:DEMO_PASSWORD}} (SET in .env) and a separate OAuth sign-up flow FILLs {{SECRET:GOOGLE_SIGNUP_TOKEN}} (unset, unrelated to login).

findings.result: ISS-t125-3 CONFIRMED FIXED: auth_wrong_creds and auth_expired_session both render 'missing credential -- set HYBRID_PASSWORD in the repo-root .env'; the OAuth pack renders the same. No green false-runnable pill.

NEW REGRESSION (ISS-t125-5): auth_wrong_creds and auth_expired_session, AND the OAuth sign-up carry-over pack, all render 'missing credential -- set GOOGLE_SIGNUP_TOKEN in the repo-root .env' even though DEMO_PASSWORD (the project's actual login credential, the only thing AUTH_WRONG_CREDS/AUTH_EXPIRED_SESSION need) is fully set in .env. GOOGLE_SIGNUP_TOKEN belongs only to the unrelated OAuth sign-up flow. The login case classes are wrongly blocked, and the operator is told to set a key that does nothing to unblock testing login with wrong credentials.

root_cause: catalog()'s cycle-3 fix computes `blocking = _missing_keys(project, _auth_secret_keys(spec))` with no `only=` restriction at all -- i.e. the UNION of every FILL-referenced secret key across EVERY flow in the spec, OAuth and non-OAuth alike -- and uses that same unrestricted union as the gate for both the generic AUTH_CLASSES rows and the OAuth pack. Any unset secret anywhere in the FlowSpec, however unrelated to a given row, now blocks that row. Confirmed to also fire for a secret belonging to a flow with NO auth/OAuth signal at all (an unrelated admin-import flow's SFTP key), see .work/checker_probe2.py and .work/checker_probe3.py.
